data.long_description:
Provident Estate is pleased to offer you this Stunning Studio Apartment for Sale at Binghatti Aquarise, Business Bay, Dubai.

Property Features:

⦁ High Floor | Direct Pool View | Large Layout
⦁ Studio
⦁ One Bathroom
⦁ 434.86 Sq. Ft.
⦁ High floor
⦁ Pool View
⦁ Semi-Furnished
⦁ Allocated parking
⦁ Shared Gym and Pool
⦁ 70/30 Payment Plan
⦁ Anticipated handover Q2 2027

Project Features:

Binghatti Aquarise is a stunning wave-inspired tower right on the Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay. It offers a luxury collection of premium residences, some featuring their own private plunge pools. Residents enjoy resort-style amenities, including an artificial beach and a rooftop infinity pool. it is the perfect blend of coastal serenity and city life.

About the Community:

Business Bay is a vibrant district in the heart of Dubai, centered around the Dubai Canal. Known for its modern residential towers and waterfront living, it offers stunning city and canal views with easy access to Downtown Dubai and major attractions.

Proximity:

It’s only 5 minutes drive to The Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa, 15 Minutes to Jumeirah Beach and 20 minutes to Dubai International Airport (DXB) so you don’t have to worry as you are close to all the Dubai iconic destinations!
